events.text: The documented journey from Rillbend Orchard Path reaches Tansyhook Crossing.

details.describedRoute: Maddoc left the small moss-green feathered seed-eater undisturbed under the Rillbend culvert, climbed back onto the public footpath, and followed the orchard lanes across a quiet, uncomplicated stretch of the Vales to Tansyhook Crossing.

hud.name: Maddoc Maddren
hud.weather: Cool and clear, with thin mist between the orchard trees
focus: Explore Tansyhook Crossing and its orchard lanes

recap:
CAMPAIGN: Maddoc Maddren (seed 3951775931)
SCENE: At Thistlebell Yard, Maddoc rebuked the arguing handlers, then approached the burden beast's twisted left-shoulder harness. Moving carefully, he freed the pinching strap and straightened it without removing the full harness. The beast held steady, flicked an ear and shifted weight more comfortably. The two handlers are now watching; the beast has not yet resumed hauling.
PC: young learner, undecided; 0 S
